name: Datadog
tagline: Deep product — agents, metrics, dashboards, monitors everywhere.
firstWin: a dashboard open with at least one metric graphed
path: open the Dashboards section from the left nav
pick a metric to graph and save
optional: Installing the Agent to send real metrics is the bigger step; you can explore built-in integrations first.

knowledge.text: Dashboards are in the left nav. New Dashboard → then drag in a Timeseries widget to start graphing.
In a Timeseries widget, pick a metric in the query editor (e.g. system.cpu.user). Built-in integration metrics appear even before you install the Agent.
The Datadog Agent runs on your hosts to send metrics/logs. Install instructions are under Integrations → Agent.
